title: list_hotels_pagination_and_filtering
description: Test the GET /api/hotels endpoint to verify it returns a paginated list of active hotels and supports filtering by location parameter correctly.

title: get_hotel_details_by_id
description: Test the GET /api/hotels/{id} endpoint to ensure it returns detailed information about a specific hotel including room types, and returns 404 for non-existent hotel IDs.

title: list_cars_pagination_and_filtering
description: Test the GET /api/cars endpoint to verify it returns a paginated list of active rental cars and supports filtering by car_type parameter correctly.

title: get_car_details_by_id
description: Test the GET /api/cars/{id} endpoint to ensure it returns detailed information about a specific car and returns 404 for non-existent car IDs.

title: user_login_with_email_and_password
description: Test the POST /api/auth/login endpoint to verify user and admin authentication with email and password, returning JWT token in HttpOnly cookie, and handling invalid credentials and missing fields.

title: user_registration_with_validation
description: Test the POST /api/auth/register endpoint to verify new user registration with email, password (minimum 8 characters), and name, including validation errors and duplicate email handling.

title: google_oauth_authentication_flow
description: Test the GET /api/auth/signin/google and /api/auth/callback/google endpoints to verify the Google OAuth authentication flow including redirection and callback handling.

title: create_booking_with_validation_and_price_calculation
description: Test the POST /api/bookings endpoint to verify booking creation for hotels or cars with validation of input data, correct total price calculation, unique booking code generation, and authentication enforcement.

title: create_stripe_checkout_session
description: Test the POST /api/checkout endpoint to verify creation of Stripe Checkout session for payment processing, supporting multiple payment methods and currencies, and handling validation errors and booking not found cases.

title: stripe_webhook_event_handling
description: Test the POST /api/webhook/stripe endpoint to verify handling of Stripe webhook events for payment status updates, including validation of webhook signatures and error handling for invalid webhooks.
